notes.title: We're Back Baby!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33072170/5d7b8aac81e68212d28dc501a0ed3fafc4a15a77.png[/img]

The game industry hasn’t stopped, so neither will we. From the creators of I Can’t Believe It’s Not Gambling comes the sequel: I Can’t Believe It’s Not Gambling 2(K).

I Can’t Believe It’s Not Gambling 2(K) is the next chapter of (totally not) gambling in video games! This time, you’ll be spinning slots to win new skins for your slot machines. We’ve included some other small features to explore too, like a new Basketball mini-game, the ability to enter fake Credit Card pins for in-game money (and secrets!), and a brand new Prestige ladder where you’ll earn Titles and skins.

Honestly, who has time to mess around with playing a full match of a simulated sport with ok animations, weird bugs, and frustrating online play? All just to get back to the real action - spinning the slot machine for sweet, sweet digital rewards! All anyone really wants is to have their brain fire off those sparks of excitement, that feeling of winning. 

The store page has just gone live, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1157790/I_Cant_Believe_Its_Not_Gambling_2K/]WISHLIST NOW[/url] to be ready for it! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33072170/bbdc0bd2c44dce22374b8e7f013eb050a67773f7.gif[/img]

This is a topic that we feel is important to discuss, so we want to use this project as a platform to talk about gambling in video games. To keep the conversation alive, we need to get this game into the right hands. We encourage you to share this game with your friends, family, and your favorite content creators! 

As a side note: We will have more news about our other project, KAIJU FISHING, in the coming weeks as well, so make sure you follow us @MutantStudios to stay up to date!

As always, we appreciate all the support,
The Mutant Studios Team

notes.title: Beta Feedback
notes.content:
Thanks so much to our initial round of Beta Testers!

We spent the first few days last week gathering up your feedback and making as many quality of life improvements as possible.

I should also mention that you guys were given a limited amount of in game cards. The full game will release with about 3x as many as you encountered in your testing rounds. And yes, we know there were quite a few bugs and more than a few hidden features. 

I'm hoping to crank out another Beta Version after crunching through the weekend which will include a ton of patches. I'll post an update here when its ready. We would love it if you could give it another round of testing once it goes live, and we would very much appreciate another round of feedback.

Thanks again, to the best Beta Testers ever!

Jeff and the MES team

notes.title: Welcome
notes.content:
The legends that brought you I Can't Believe It's Not Gambling present... STEAMULATOR 2018. Balance players, developers, money, and morality as you curate all your favorite games in this epic storefront challenge!

*Note: This game is purely for parody. You will not actually be releasing any games or making any real money. Side effects of 'Steamulator 2018' may include: nausea, upset stomach, crossed eyes, long sighs as you realize how much more you could be doing with your life, deep regret purchasing this parody game and all your life choices up to this point. I mean really... like, remember that time in high school when that thing happened to you... man, how would things have turned out if you had handled that differently... oh well, you'll never know now, but at least you can rail against the injustice of it all by complaining loudly about this "game" on the internet. Hey maybe you can even get these stupid devs fired, that would really show 'em...

If you experience any of these things for more than 4 hours, consider calling your doctor immediately, or play any real game...*

The Mutant Entertainment Studios Team
